maintenance_led.reason: Revenue is asset management fees from affiliate investment firms' funds, not repair, servicing or replacement of installed items.

publicly_funded.reason: Clients are institutional investors, financial advisors and individual investors paying fees on managed assets, not government payers.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows mainly through affiliates' investment performance, flows and distribution; new stakes in affiliates are only a few per year.

mission_critical.reason: Investors can redeem or reallocate from affiliate funds and strategies fairly easily; no deep integration or regulatory lock-in.

notes: Serial acquirer is a judgment call: AMG regularly takes stakes in new affiliates, but at a modest pace.
